engineers: The 2008 pilot found seawater desalination on the ship channel technically feasible (microfiltration + RO), but a difficult source: a full 25 MGD design would have to be conservative and therefore expensive. The recommendation was not to build 25 MGD next, but a 2.5 MGD demonstration plant first (intake and concentrate disposal at full size), then 12.5 and 25 MGD.
source: NRS Consulting Engineers, Texas Seawater Desalination Demonstration Project, Final Pilot Study Report, October 2008 (PDF p.7, p.14)
